text:
Aj Patel: heading into the 7pm->3am swing — running ~35m late. Sorry all, stuck in a meeting. Leo Romero can you be primary until I get on? I can take over remotely once I land. asking to confirm pager rules so we don’t have a coverage gap.

Leo Romero: yep can do, I'll be primary until you say otherwise. quick Q — if something triggers a P1 during the delay do we page eng-oncall-lead immediately or try local mitigation first?

Tasha Nguyen: short answer: page lead immediately for P1. we have a 0-5 minute tolerance for quick recoveries but for anything customer-facing we escalate right away. P2 = try local mitigation for up to 10m (if no progress escalate). P3 = monitor and log.

Maria Chen: adding the customer-impact checklist we use:
- if >1% customers or majority of enterprise orgs are broken => P1
- if single enterprise with SLA impact => P1 and page account-eng + eng-oncall-lead
- if non-prod or degraded non-blocking behavior => P2
link: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/oncall/customer-impact (see "severity decision matrix")

Aj Patel: good, that matches what I remember but wanted explicit confirmation. also: what about paging order for P1? who is first/second/third?

Tasha Nguyen: paging order (short):
1) current primary (whoever is on pager)
2) secondary oncall (if primary doesn't ack in 60s or explicitly hands off)
3) eng-oncall-lead (immediate for P1 if primary unavailable or if incident is org-wide)
4) sla-escalation (account-eng) for customer-impacting incidents
We keep the 60s ack rule only for non-urgent tactical; for P1 assume immediate escalation path.

Leo Romero: to be explicit for tonight while Aj is en route: I'm primary, Tasha you're secondary (if that's ok). If I don't respond within 60s on a P1 -> page eng-oncall-lead right away.

Aj Patel: confirmed. Tasha = secondary is fine. I'll update rotation in the oncall doc. I'm also going to enable my phone forwarding so pages ring.

ops-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff annotation: Aj Patel flagged late arrival at 2026-03-14T18:12:01Z. Temporary primary: Leo Romero until 2026-03-14T18:47:00Z or until Aj confirms takeover.

incident-bot: INCIDENT ROUTING CHECK: current policy = "default-paging-v3". For P1: pages -> current primary, eng-oncall-lead, oncall-sre. For P2: pages -> current primary, secondary, ops-bridge (after 10m).

Maria Chen: copy on the policy. also two practical runbook pointers for quick handoffs:
1) run `oncall status` to confirm who is primary/secondary and who has current ack token.
2) if taking over mid-incident, post a one-line "assume" message in the thread: e.g., `Maria Chen: assuming primary at 18:20 - running step 1 of runbook` so downstream folks know who to coordinate with.

Aj Patel: logging that now — Aj Patel: assuming primary handoff (remote) at 18:46 because I'm 10m out. I'll join Zoom if we need a bridge.

Leo Romero: :thumbsup: one more operational note — if you need to escalate to on-call lead while I'm primary, call the Pager number first then post in this thread. voice helps for P1.

Tasha Nguyen: and if the incident has error-rate spike, do a quick `metrics span` check and paste top 3 failing endpoints in the thread. that's usually enough for lead to make triage decisions.

Aj Patel: got it. final: if any page goes to eng-oncall-lead, please also ping @account-eng for customer-facing incidents (we don't want surprises). I'll update the personal handoff note in the docs after I land. Thanks everyone.

Leo Romero: acknowledged. standing by as primary.

ops-bot: REMINDER: handoff complete when root oncall confirms in this thread or `oncall confirm-handoff` CLI is used.

Aj Patel: done — `oncall confirm-handoff --from Aj --to Aj` (remote). thanks, closing the temporary-coverage note when I sign on.
